question: For the SAME tax-instructions/1796-cookbook pair, what common words did the revised top-25 rule exclude, and why? Bind old/new rule versions to the same source pair. Distinguish mechanical exclusion from a claim that excluded words are irrelevant to a question.
sender_claim: Adva-side assistant; this label is not authenticated identity
intended_receiver: An authorized operator of the local AEG working repository
permission_boundary: Only information the responding operator is authorized to disclose. Do not include secrets, private document copies or private filesystem paths. Opaque local record labels are sufficient.
budget_enforcement: Receiver checks reply byte size and fixed field bounds; source inspection time is a requested limit, not remotely enforced.
acceptance_scope: Literal differences between disclosed strings only. No source authenticity, projection faithfulness, theorem, learning, native free or universal grammar completeness is established.

requested_projection.task: Name the fixed pair with opaque labels and the exact old/new score formulas; label unknown details.
requested_projection.result: Give up to eight authorized excluded common-word examples and their mechanical exclusion reasons; optional structured attachment described below.
requested_projection.residual: State whether this is a complete or sampled disclosure, what could not be checked, and whether relevance was judged or only stipulated.

supplement.fields: request_sha256, pair_labels, rule_versions, normalization_and_tie_breaking, score_formulas, head_left, head_right, dropped_examples [{word, old_membership_evidence, new_exclusion_reason}], coverage, omissions
supplement.limits: Explicit nulls/Unknown allowed. Disclose only authorized excerpts. Full source texts and private paths are not requested. The existing checker does not validate this optional attachment; further checking remains a separate obligation.
